articles.title: 5 shows to watch if you miss Outlander (and are waiting for Outlander: Blood of My Blood season 2)
articles.summary: The article discusses the irresistible appeal of period dramas like "Outlander" and its prequel "Outlander: Blood of My Blood." It highlights key elements that captivate audiences, such as passionate leading couples, detailed historical settings, and compelling narratives, making them popular entertainment choices globally for their rich storytelling.

articles.title: Russia and India Discuss Su-57E Stealth Fighter Licensing
articles.summary: Russia and India are reportedly discussing the licensing of Russia's advanced Su-57E stealth fighter. This potential deal indicates India's interest in acquiring cutting-edge air superiority capabilities, possibly for domestic production. Such a collaboration would significantly strengthen defence ties and modernize India's air force with fifth-generation fighter technology, impacting regional security dynamics.

articles.title: NIA conducts raids in Kerala over explosives seizure
articles.summary: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) recently conducted raids across Kerala following the seizure of explosives. These operations highlight ongoing efforts by national security agencies to counter potential threats within the country. The raids underscore the NIA's mandate to investigate serious offenses impacting India's internal security, ensuring the safety and stability of the nation.

articles.title: NSA Doval meets Patrushev in Moscow, discusses maritime, defence ties
articles.summary: India's National Security Advisor Ajit Doval met Russia's Nikolai Patrushev, Aide to the President and Maritime Board Chairman, in Moscow. Their high-level discussions focused on advancing bilateral cooperation. This interaction underscores the continued strategic dialogue between India and Russia, aiming to strengthen security, defence, and maritime ties, crucial for both nations' geopolitical interests.

articles.title: Ukraine military destroys Russian naval aircraft and missile systems in wild video
articles.summary: The Ukrainian military showcased a successful operation in the Black Sea, using drones to destroy two Russian planes and a key missile system. This incident, documented in a released video, underscores the ongoing intensity of the Ukraine-Russia conflict and demonstrates the growing effectiveness of drone warfare in achieving strategic military objectives against air and missile assets.

articles.title: India signs BrahMos missile deal with Vietnam, Indonesia pact in final stages
articles.summary: India has secured a significant deal to supply BrahMos missiles, jointly developed with Russia, to Vietnam. Furthermore, a similar agreement with Indonesia is in its final stages. This move highlights India's emergence as a key defence exporter and strengthens its strategic partnerships in Southeast Asia, bolstering regional security and showcasing India's advanced defence manufacturing capabilities.

articles.title: Zelensky cheers Ukraine drone strikes on Putin's planes, missiles and oil industry deep into Russian territory
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky lauded successful overnight drone strikes deep inside Russian territory, targeting aircraft, missile facilities, and oil infrastructure. These attacks reportedly caused fires at critical oil facilities, highlighting Ukraine's expanding drone capabilities and its strategy to disrupt Russian military and economic assets far from the front lines, intensifying the ongoing conflict.
